title: Rav Chinena bar Bisna
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Beitzah 22a, saying: “Here we are dealing with a candelabrum made of segments.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Yitzchak bar Bisna, which Hyman gives as the reason Yuchasin did not mention him. Seder HaDorot, under the entry Rabbi Chana bar Bizna, states that they are one.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Beitzah 22a names Rav Chinena bar Bisna. Hyman’s explanation of Yuchasin’s omission and Seder HaDorot’s proposed identification remain attributed bibliographic claims.
The consulted Beitzah 22a supports the name and the candelabrum episode. The printed variants remain Hyman’s reports.
